endpoints.name: List public posts
endpoints.description: Anonymous feed: at most 50 ACTIVE PUBLIC posts. Response data is an array; anonymous reaction summaries are empty.

endpoints.name: Get public post
endpoints.description: Anonymous detail for an ACTIVE PUBLIC post. FRIENDS, ONLY_ME, deleted, or nonexistent posts return 404.

endpoints.name: Create post
endpoints.description: Requires nonblank content or nonempty media. Privacy is PUBLIC, FRIENDS, or ONLY_ME; omitted privacy defaults to PUBLIC. Each tagged UUID produces a POST_MENTION Kafka event. Author details are fetched from identity-service.

endpoints.name: List authenticated feed
endpoints.description: Returns an array filtered by privacy, friendship, and blocking. Calls user-service for friendship/block status and identity-service for author profiles.

endpoints.name: Get cursor feed page
endpoints.description: Returns data {items,nextCursor,hasMore}. Limit must be 1..50. Omit cursor for the first page; use the returned opaque nextCursor for later pages. Invalid limits/cursors return 400.

endpoints.name: Search explore page
endpoints.description: Required q is trimmed, lowercased, and must contain at least two characters after an optional leading #. Searches content/hashtags among the latest 500 visible posts. Returns {items,nextCursor,hasMore}; limit 1..50.

endpoints.name: List trending hashtags
endpoints.description: Returns [{tag,postCount,windowSize}]. Counts each hashtag once per visible post among the latest 500 posts. Limit must be 1..50.

endpoints.name: List my posts
endpoints.description: Returns the current user's ACTIVE posts with author details and reaction summaries.

endpoints.name: Get authenticated post
endpoints.description: Returns PostResponse. A nonowner denied by privacy or blocking receives 404. Deleted or nonexistent posts also return 404.

endpoints.name: Share visible post
endpoints.description: Optional body {caption}. Creates a PUBLIC wrapper with originalPostId; sharing an existing share resolves the root original post. Caller must be able to view the original. data.sharedPost describes original availability.

endpoints.name: Update owned post
endpoints.description: Only the post owner can update it; a nonowner receives 403. Omitted media/privacy preserves the previous values. Content is normalized even when omitted, so send content intentionally.

endpoints.name: Delete owned post
endpoints.description: Soft-delete changes status to DELETED and returns 200 with data:null. Only the owner may delete (403 otherwise); a subsequent GET returns 404. Use only IDs created by the current test run.

endpoints.name: List user profile posts
endpoints.description: Returns a target user's ACTIVE posts filtered for the current viewer using user-service friendship and blocking policies.

endpoints.name: List user profile images
endpoints.description: Returns [{postId,url,publicId,createdAt}] from visible ACTIVE posts. Includes IMAGE media only.

endpoints.name: Create comment
endpoints.description: Requires nonblank content. Optional parentCommentId must identify an ACTIVE comment on the same post. Root comments notify the post owner; replies notify the parent author; self-notifications are suppressed. Tags emit COMMENT_MENTION for other users.

endpoints.name: List visible post comments
endpoints.description: Returns ACTIVE comments ordered by createdAt ascending, with parentCommentId and reactionSummary. The viewer must be able to view the containing post.

endpoints.name: Update owned comment
endpoints.description: Only the comment owner can change its content (403 otherwise). The containing post must remain visible to the viewer. Blank content returns 400.

endpoints.name: Delete owned comment and replies
endpoints.description: Returns 200 with data:null. Soft-deletes the owned comment and its ACTIVE recursive replies, then decrements post.commentsCount. Post ownership alone does not authorize deletion of another user's comment.

endpoints.name: List post reactions
endpoints.description: Returns [{userId,username,displayName,avatarUrl,type,reactedAt}]. Requires target/post visibility and obtains user profiles from identity-service.

endpoints.name: React to post
endpoints.description: Requires type LIKE, LOVE, HAHA, WOW, SAD, or ANGRY. Returns {totalCount,currentUserReaction,breakdown}. Repeating the same existing type toggles the reaction OFF; a different type changes it. A newly created nonself post reaction emits POST_LIKE; comment reactions do not emit notification events.

endpoints.name: Change post reaction
endpoints.description: Alias of POST reaction, including same-type toggle-off behavior. Use a different type to test a change. Returns {totalCount,currentUserReaction,breakdown}.

endpoints.name: Remove my post reaction
endpoints.description: Explicitly removes the current user's reaction. Returns a 200 summary with currentUserReaction:null. An already absent reaction is a no-op.

endpoints.name: List comment reactions
endpoints.description: Returns [{userId,username,displayName,avatarUrl,type,reactedAt}]. Requires target/post visibility and obtains user profiles from identity-service.

endpoints.name: React to comment
endpoints.description: Requires type LIKE, LOVE, HAHA, WOW, SAD, or ANGRY. Returns {totalCount,currentUserReaction,breakdown}. Repeating the same existing type toggles the reaction OFF; a different type changes it. A newly created nonself post reaction emits POST_LIKE; comment reactions do not emit notification events.

endpoints.name: Change comment reaction
endpoints.description: Alias of POST reaction, including same-type toggle-off behavior. Use a different type to test a change. Returns {totalCount,currentUserReaction,breakdown}.

endpoints.name: Remove my comment reaction
endpoints.description: Explicitly removes the current user's reaction. Returns a 200 summary with currentUserReaction:null. An already absent reaction is a no-op.

endpoints.name: Upload post image
endpoints.description: Requires multipart field file containing a nonempty image/* up to 10 MiB. Postman/Newman must set the multipart boundary. Requires real Cloudinary configuration; omit from the isolated core test run. Returns MediaUploadResponse with type,url,publicId,width,height,format,bytes. No upload-delete API exists.

endpoints.name: Upload chat attachment
endpoints.description: Requires multipart field file. Accepts images up to 50 MiB, videos up to 500 MiB, or PDF/DOCX up to 50 MiB. Requires real Cloudinary configuration; omit from the isolated core run. Returns MediaUploadResponse. No upload-delete API exists.

endpoints.name: Get social metrics
endpoints.description: Direct social-service endpoint requiring an ADMIN bearer token. The gateway /api/admin route belongs to admin-service. Returns data {posts,comments,reactions}.

endpoints.name: Get social growth
endpoints.description: Direct social-service ADMIN endpoint. Optional ISO dates from/to default to the last 30 days. MONTH selects monthly buckets; other values select daily buckets. An ordered range of at most two years is required. Returns [{period,posts,comments,reactions}].

endpoints.name: Inspect moderation content
endpoints.description: Direct social-service ADMIN endpoint. target_type is POST or COMMENT and the ID must match that target type. Includes inactive/deleted content for moderation. Missing content returns 404.

endpoints.name: Hide moderation content
endpoints.description: ADMIN only. Requires moderationReason: SPAM, HARASSMENT, HATE_SPEECH, VIOLENCE, NUDITY, FALSE_INFORMATION, IMPERSONATION, or OTHER. Optional note is at most 2000 characters. ACTIVE -> INACTIVE; other states return 400. Returns {content,previousStatus}. This internal adapter does not itself create an admin audit.

endpoints.name: Remove moderation content
endpoints.description: ADMIN only. Soft-deletes ACTIVE/INACTIVE -> DELETED; already deleted content returns 400. Same moderationReason and note validation as hide. Returns {content,previousStatus}. Use only dedicated test-run fixture IDs.

endpoints.name: List my notifications
endpoints.description: Returns the current receiver's notifications, newest first, excluding MESSAGE type. Fields: id,receiverId,actorId,actorName,actorAvatar,type,targetId,message,isRead,createdAt. Poll for a matching targetId/type/actorId after Kafka-producing actions.

endpoints.name: Get my unread notification count
endpoints.description: Returns a numeric unread count, excluding MESSAGE type. Use fresh dedicated test actors for deterministic count assertions.

endpoints.name: Get my notification
endpoints.description: Returns 200 only when the notification belongs to the authenticated receiver. The source throws an unhandled IllegalArgumentException for foreign/missing IDs; security tests should require a 4xx response and report a possible 500 as a defect.

endpoints.name: Mark my notification read
endpoints.description: Returns NotificationResponse with isRead=true. Repeated reads remain true. Repository lookup enforces ownership; foreign/missing IDs have the same unhandled-exception defect as GET.

endpoints.name: Mark all my notifications read
endpoints.description: Returns 200 with data:null. Marks the current receiver's non-MESSAGE unread notifications as read and pushes the unread count. Run only with dedicated integration-test actors.

notes: 38 distinct HTTP operations: social-service 33 (posts 14, comments 4, reactions 8, media 2, internal admin 5), notification-service 5. The source has no stories HTTP controller.

Success responses wrap {success:true,message,data}. Social 400/403/404 errors wrap {success:false,message} without data. Missing-bearer 401 returns {success:false,message:'Unauthorized'}. Invalid enum/JSON or missing multipart parameters may use Spring's default error response, so do not assume every 4xx has the same envelope.

PostResponse: id,slug,author,content,privacy,originalPostId,sharedPost,media,taggedUserIds,taggedUsers,reactionsCount,reactionSummary,commentsCount,status,createdAt,updatedAt. CommentResponse: id,postId,parentCommentId,author,content,taggedUserIds,reactionsCount,reactionSummary,status,createdAt,updatedAt. Author objects use id,username,displayName,avatarUrl.

Cross-service author profiles use GET /api/users/internal/profiles; friendship uses GET /api/friends/status/{targetUserId}; blocking uses GET /api/blocks/status/{targetUserId}. Eureka resolves Feign service names and forwarding configuration passes the request JWT.
PostService fails closed when a block lookup fails and treats a failed friendship lookup as not friends. Therefore B reading even a PUBLIC post depends on a healthy user-service.

Potential security gap: PostService checks blocking, while CommentService and ReactionService only check privacy/friendship. Add blocked comment/reaction regression tests that expect denial; report any unauthorized success as a finding.

Notification service has no global exception handler for IllegalArgumentException in getNotification/markAsRead. A foreign or missing notification ID can yield 500. Tests should demand a 4xx response and expose this defect.

Kafka topic notification-events carries POST_MENTION, POST_COMMENT, COMMENT_REPLY, COMMENT_MENTION, and POST_LIKE. POST_LIKE is emitted only when a reaction is first created, not when its type changes. Comment reactions produce no notification event. Poll matching type/targetId/actorId with a bounded timeout.

Notification list, unread-count, and read-all exclude MESSAGE by design. Do not assert chat MESSAGE delivery through this list. The user-created Kafka topic also creates WELCOME notifications asynchronously.

Media requests belong in an optional provider folder. Metadata uses bodyMode:'formdata' and formData with file source fixture_media_path. Do not hardcode multipart Content-Type. Core isolated integration tests must not require real Cloudinary credentials.
Internal social admin endpoints require an ADMIN JWT and direct social_base_url. Do not send them through the gateway /api/admin route, which belongs to admin-service.
Deletes are soft-deletes. Delete only IDs generated by the current run. These services expose no API to delete notification rows, uploaded Cloudinary assets, or users.
